title: Arabesque
identity: Pierre Villette’s Arabesque is for alto saxophone and piano or orchestra, Leduc AL27378. The 1993 Philharmonie de Paris guide gives 10 minutes, describes the piece as musically focused without technical difficulty, and reports that the orchestra version was then unavailable from the publisher. A current Como conservatory first-cycle admission syllabus lists the alto-and-piano work in Group 3. The local catalog’s approximate 8:30 remains a separate source value.
